name: web_share
title: Web Share
description: Opens the operating system's share sheet for a URL, text or file. The button hides itself where the Web Share API is unavailable.

attributes.name: data-web-share
attributes.description: Enables the behavior. Start the button hidden; it is shown only where sharing is supported.

attributes.name: data-web-share-file
attributes.description: URL of a file to download and share as a file.

actions.name: share
actions.description: Calls navigator.share() with the data attributes. Errors and cancellations are ignored.

notes: Shared files are named my_application_<random>.<extension>. Change the APPLICATION_NAME constant at the top of web_share.js to use your app's name.

examples.title: Share a URL and a file
examples.description: The buttons only appear in browsers that support sharing.
